PATHS.name: The cornerstone: the Bible stands
PATHS.desc: The argument every other conversation depends on: the Quran affirms the Bible of Muhammad's day, the manuscripts prove that Bible is ours, and the corruption claim dies on either horn of the dilemma.

PATHS.name: The five strongest cases
PATHS.desc: The claims with the most decisive evidence and the least answer — start here if you read nothing else.

PATHS.name: For gospel conversations
PATHS.desc: The cases that lead most naturally to the gospel itself — the scales against grace, the Quran's own exalted Jesus, and the sacrifice at the heart of Eid.

PATHS.desc: Where popular polemics overreach — the weak muddy-spring hadith, the taqiyya stereotype, the Rome prophecy, and the qira'at overclaim. Knowing these keeps your strong arguments credible.

TIMELINE.p: Psalm 22 describes pierced hands and divided garments a millennium before the cross.
The complete Isaiah — including chapter 53 — sealed in a Qumran cave 750 years before Muhammad.
Attested by every early source, Christian and pagan; called indisputable by skeptical historians.
1 Corinthians 15:3-8 — datable to within a few years of the events.
The clay-birds legend — later retold in Quran 3:49 as history.
Complete Bibles, 200+ years before Muhammad, matching today's text.
Waraqa — Khadija's Christian cousin who 'used to write the Gospel in Arabic' — interprets the experience.
Background of Surah 30's Rome prediction — the one claimed prophecy.

TIMELINE.t: The Quran affirms the Torah and Gospel
TIMELINE.p: 'Ask those who read the Scripture before you' (10:94); 'let the People of the Gospel judge' (5:47).
Administered as a prophethood test; his companion dies of it.
'I feel as if my aorta is being cut from that poison' (Bukhari 4428) — the punishment 69:46 names for a false prophet.
Reciters die in battle; Umar fears 'a large part of the Quran may be lost'; Zayd collects it from palm stalks and memory.
Muslims 'differing as the Jews and Christians differed'; all variant copies ordered burnt (Bukhari 4987).
A non-Uthmanic Quran text, erased and overwritten — rediscovered in 1972.
Bukhari and Muslim collect the reports — including Aisha's age, the lost verses, and the deathbed words — 150–250 years after the events.
The first major scholar to teach the Bible's TEXT was corrupted — four centuries after Muhammad.
The Hafs reading becomes the near-universal printed Quran; Warsh persists in Africa — two texts in print today.
The pre-Muhammad Bible surfaces at Qumran — and it is our Bible. The corruption window closes.
